messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Neha Gupta
Delhi | neha.gupta@example.com

Summary:
Data analyst who turns product data into decisions for growth and marketing teams.

Skills:
SQL, Excel, Python (pandas), Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Google Analytics, A/B testing, statistics

Experience:
Senior Data Analyst, Zepto (2022 - Present)
Designed the A/B testing framework used for all checkout experiments, with sequential testing.
Built a Tableau dashboard for city-level unit economics viewed daily by the leadership team.
Identified that delivery delays above 12 minutes drove churn, informing a dark-store expansion.

Data Analyst, Policybazaar (2020 - 2022)
Automated weekly marketing funnel reports in SQL and Python, saving 10 hours a week.
Built customer segmentation using k-means clustering for targeted campaigns.

Education:
MBA Business Analytics, Symbiosis Pune, 2020
B.Com, Delhi University, 2018

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
